name: DRBHCOM
recent: DRB-HICOM 在2026年第三季度转亏为盈，净利约1.02亿令吉，营收超过60亿令吉，主要受 Proton 销售强劲带动。公司近期与多方签署谅解备忘录，同时 EPF 持续申报其作为主要股东的持股变动。
notable: 公司签署了谅解备忘录（MOU），具体内容未在标题中披露。
2026年第三季度转亏为盈，净利约1.02亿令吉，营收超过60亿令吉。
EPF 在2026年9月至10月期间多次申报作为主要股东的持股变动。
risks: EPF 作为主要股东多次申报持股变动，具体增减方向未在标题中说明。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日的季度，营收为55.03亿令吉，环比增长15.6%，同比增长33.1%；净利为4134.8万令吉，环比下降23.6%，同比下降38.6%；净利率为0.8%，低于上一季度的1.1%。

recent_en: DRB-HICOM returned to profit in 3Q2026 with net profit of about RM102 million and revenue exceeding RM6 billion, driven by strong Proton sales. The company recently signed memoranda of understanding with several parties, while EPF continued to file changes in its substantial shareholder holdings.
notable_en: The company signed memoranda of understanding (MOUs), with details not disclosed in the titles.
Returned to profit in 3Q2026 with net profit of about RM102 million and revenue exceeding RM6 billion.
EPF filed multiple changes in its substantial shareholder holdings between September and October 2026.
risks_en: EPF, a substantial shareholder, filed multiple changes in holdings; the direction of change is not specified in the titles.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM5.503 billion, up 15.6% QoQ and 33.1% YoY; net income was RM41.348 million, down 23.6% QoQ and 38.6% YoY; net margin was 0.8%, lower than 1.1% in the previous quarter.
